comment: Every feature of the port, per platform. A feature is global (it must behave the same on Windows and Linux), windows or linux (it exists on one platform only, and the other says PLATFORM_ONLY with the reason). shared evidence is a suite that runs on both platforms and must pass on both; windows and linux evidence are suites of one platform. A platform status is PASS (every evidence suite exists, names the feature, and passed in this run), FAIL, BLOCKED (with the reason: nothing proves it on that platform yet) or PLATFORM_ONLY. A global feature whose two platforms differ fails the gate: tools\test.ps1 prints FEATURE and FEATURE_PARITY lines for each one.
